dossiers.financial_spine: Krystal Integrated Services (integrated facilities management — labour-heavy, thin-margin, government-contract-heavy). FY26 revenue-led growth but poor/volatile cash conversion: FY26 OCF +Rs26cr / PAT ~Rs64cr (OCF/PAT 0.41); FY25 was OCF -Rs32cr on ~Rs60cr PAT. 5y-cumulative OCF/PAT ~0.37. ROCE declining 27->21->17->16->15.9% over 4 years; EBITDA margin 6.54%.
dossiers.drivers: Contract wins (govt + private FM); labour arbitrage; receivable collection cadence on govt milestones. Growth is revenue-led, not margin-led.
dossiers.dependencies: Government-client payment cycles; minimum-wage/labour cost pass-through; working-capital funding lines.
dossiers.forensics: CRISIL DOWNGRADE 30-Apr-2026: A-/Stable -> BBB+/NEGATIVE + A2, citing debtor days ~120, Rs93.21cr loans ON-LENT to group companies (the one governance blemish), WC-limit over-utilisation and DELAYS IN STATUTORY PAYMENTS (liquidity-stress signal). Governance otherwise clean: promoter 69.96%, ZERO pledge unchanged since IPO, Piotroski 7. Earnings quality: falling PBT propped by low tax (likely s.80JJAA) + rising other income. NOT a base-effect mirage.

valuation.method: 10-13x tax-normalised EPS + 7-9x EV/EBITDA; card FV ~600 = no MoS

dossiers.prediction: 30d in-line to -4%; 60d -0 to -6%; 90d -4% to -12% base case, with a >=15% drawdown tail (~Rs460-500) on any further rating action or a Q1FY27 collection miss. Bull-falsifier: 2 straight quarters OCF/PAT >0.8x + debtor days <100 + CRISIL outlook back to Stable.

dossiers.financial_spine: Saatvik Green Energy — solar PV MODULE maker (Ambala ~4.8GW, ~100% util), NOT yet backward-integrated; fresh IPO (listed 26-Sep-2025 @ Rs465, CMP ~Rs466). FY26 PAT Rs357cr but OCF -Rs27cr (OCF/PAT -0.08; FY25 0.20, FY24 0.44 — monotonic collapse to cash-negative). EBITDA margin 12.78% (-388bps YoY); Q4 operating margin collapsed to 6.69% (19.3->14.1->12.0->6.69 through FY26). ROCE 32.9% (halved from ~52%).
dossiers.drivers: Module ASP + spreads (deflating); order book ~Rs8,000cr; the unproven backward-integration (Odisha cell line) margin recovery in H2-FY27; capacity utilisation.
dossiers.dependencies: Solar module ASP / oversupply cycle; DCR/ALMM domestic premium; cell-import cost (until Odisha cells commission); large debt/equity-funded capex.
dossiers.forensics: Growth is debt/equity-funded, not cash-backed: FCF -Rs628cr (OCF -27 - capex Rs601cr), zero dividend; net debt ~Rs858cr (net-debt/EBITDA ~1.5x). Governance CLEAN (promoter 75.99%, 0% pledge) — thesis is earnings-quality/oversupply, not pledge. Soft flags: di-worsification into ~10 verticals (incl. 80% Melcon transformer buy).

valuation.method: normalized FY27 margins; Street TPs 520-565 are growth-continuation contingent on an unproven margin V-recovery

dossiers.prediction: 30d underperform >=3 pts; 60d Q1FY27 operating margin prints <=~11% (no V-recovery); 90d underperform >=5 pts with CFO/FCF still negative, de-rating toward Rs380-420. Hard bear-falsifier: Q1-Q2FY27 EBITDA margin re-expands >13% AND CFO turns positive AND Odisha cell line commissions on-budget.

dossiers.financial_spine: Ceinsys Tech (formerly ADCC Infocad) — geospatial + engineering services, ~70% government revenue, Nagpur (Meghe family). +111% PAT flattered by a one-off ~15% tax rate (guides to 25% FY27-28 = ~Rs15-16cr / ~10% PAT headwind), inorganic AllyGrow/VTS revenue, and ~18%-of-PBT treasury other income. Q4 PAT already slipped -4.4% QoQ. Standalone PAT Rs154cr > consolidated Rs133cr (US subsidiary drags ~Rs21cr).
dossiers.drivers: Government geospatial/engineering order flow; AllyGrow/VTS acquisitions; unbilled-revenue conversion.
dossiers.dependencies: Government-milestone collection cycle; Ind AS 115 revenue-recognition on long-cycle contracts; tax-rate normalisation.
dossiers.forensics: OCF/PAT ~0.02 (FY26 OCF Rs3-5cr vs PAT Rs133cr; accrual ~98% — the decisive number). Receivables ~255 days incl ~Rs330cr unbilled (trade-only 72-85d; screener's 'improved 83d' is an optical artifact of the 58%-bigger revenue denominator). Auditor (Chaturvedi & Shah) CLEAN but sole Key Audit Matter = Ind AS 115 revenue/unbilled recognition (ring-fences the concern). Pledge modest (~12% of promoter, falling). Net CASH -Rs248cr; ROCE 27% / ROIC 24% (returns genuinely strong — WC drag is a return/dilution problem, not solvency).

valuation.method: ~12-14x P/E converging with MarketsMojo Rs875 HOLD; cheap-for-a-reason

dossiers.prediction: Underperforms Nifty by ~4-10% over 90d. Thesis wrong if Q1FY27 OCF/PAT > ~0.6x AND unbilled revenue declines (proves timing not structural). Downside trigger: any large govt-receivable stretch / WC-driven guidance cut -> >=12-15% idiosyncratic drawdown.

dossiers.financial_spine: Wanbury (API/pharma manufacturer). FY26 reported PAT Rs66.1cr is NOT cash-backed (OCF/PAT ~0.48, FCF ~-Rs24cr) — flattered by a deferred-tax credit + rising working capital (receivable days 56->80). The one genuinely durable driver: EBITDA margin 16.5% (+330bps YoY, real operating improvement). Stock ~doubled off its Rs162 low into the good news.
dossiers.drivers: API volume + margin; 4-molecule FY27 pipeline; interest-cost step-down post-refinance (sub-10% funding); deferred-tax shield while carry-forward losses last.
dossiers.dependencies: API pricing/regulatory (USFDA/EU); refinancing terms; working-capital funding.
dossiers.forensics: SEED CORRECTED: net-debt/EBITDA ~1.8-2.0x NOW (not the seed's 3.0-3.4x — that stress was FY23-24 on near-zero equity). ROE 68-77% is an ARTIFACT — tangible net worth -Rs12.85cr (FY23) -> Rs22cr (FY24) -> ~Rs145cr (FY26); arithmetic on a recovering-from-negative denominator. Promoter PLEDGE being extinguished to ~0% (Axis/Poonawalla refinance + Catalyst release 09-Jul-2026), promoters INCREASING stake 39.6->43.0%. But genuinely distressed credit history (CDR 2011, negative net worth 2015/16, Infomerics C+/Negative 'Issuer Not Cooperating' Oct-2024, zero MF holding) keeps it below value-grade.

valuation.method: normalized-earnings; Street base Rs330 is the optimistic bound; ~0% MoS even vs Street

dossiers.prediction: Underperforms Nifty by >=5 pts / draws down >=8% in 30d (catalysts now known, at 52-wk highs); by 90d underperforms Nifty by >=10 pts or trades back below Rs280 as the interest-cost step-down + deferred-tax credit annualize and the +117% base effect fades.

dossiers.financial_spine: Eternal Ltd (renamed Zomato holdco; parent of Zomato + Blinkit + Hyperpure + District). Cash-rich, un-levered. Reported FY26 PAT Rs366cr is 100%+ treasury Other Income (Rs1,396cr > PBT Rs615cr) — operating PBT ~ -Rs780cr. ROCE ~2.97% / ROE 1.19% (structurally sub-cost-of-capital). This is a VALUATION case, not a cash-quality case.
dossiers.drivers: Blinkit blended contribution margin / adj-EBITDA path (crossed breakeven Q4 +Rs37cr, +0.3% of NOV -> target ~5-6% of NOV); food-delivery cash engine (~5.5% of NOV, Rs532cr); District/Hyperpure. The multiple prices FY29 $1bn-EBITDA target as if delivered.
dossiers.dependencies: Quick-commerce competitive intensity (Zepto -Rs5,041cr, Instamart -Rs858cr/qtr, Flipkart Minutes, Amazon); discounting discipline; NOV growth.
dossiers.forensics: Net CASH ~ -Rs1,523cr (borrowings ~all leases); ~-Rs13,400cr incl full ~Rs18,000cr treasury. FCF -Rs1,119cr (OCF Rs632cr - capex Rs1,751cr) absorbed painlessly by the cash pile. Bull survives on OPERATIONS (Blinkit winning q-comm ~46-50%+ share PROFITABLY while rivals bleed) — quality yes, cash real yes, PRICE no.

valuation.method: discount the FY29 $1bn-EBITDA target back -> ~Rs205-240 today; real trailing P/E ~756x / EV-EBITDA ~200x (seed 380x/135x was conservative)

dossiers.prediction: 30d in-line to -4%; 60d -3% to -8% (re-tests at Q1FY27 if Blinkit blended margin stalls <=0.5% of NOV); 90d base -5% to -12%, hard left-tail >=15-20% drawdown toward Rs200-220 on any q-commerce discounting relapse. Hardest disconfirmer: Q1FY27 Blinkit blended adj-EBITDA >=2% of NOV + consolidated beat + positive FCF.
